summary: This line chart compares the maximum utility achieved by LLM-based and Template-based methods over a series of iteration steps. The x-axis represents iteration steps ranging from 0 to 20, while the y-axis shows the maximum utility values, peaking around 24. The chart includes p-values at specific iteration steps, indicating statistical significance. The LLM-based method consistently outperforms the Template-based method, as shown by the higher utility values. Shaded areas around each line represent the standard deviation, providing a visual indication of variability. The chart highlights the effectiveness of LLM-based methods in achieving higher utility across iterations.
